serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:106.88pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">June&#160;30, 2026</span><span style="font-family:'Times New </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:378.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">not</span><span serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">future lease payments of </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:158.93pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">$64 million</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:205.28pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">. The related right of use asset and operating lease liability will be recorded on the </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:117pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">lease commencement date and are not reflected on the Company&#8217;s condensed combined balance sheets as of </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:494.03pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">June&#160;30, 2026</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:549.85pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">. </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:129pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">These leases are expected to begin in </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:209.11pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">2026</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:229.11pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre"> and continue through 2037, with lease terms ranging from </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:517.75pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">.</span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:153pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:bold;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">Legal &amp; Regulatory Matters</span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:177pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:82.44pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">In the normal course of business both in the United States and abroad, the Company and its subsidiaries are </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:189pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">defendants in legal proceedings and are subjected to government and regulatory proceedings, investigations and inquiries. </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:201pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">The Company is involved in various pending legal proceedings arising out of the ordinary course of the Company&#8217;s </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:213pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">business. None of these legal proceedings is expected to have a mater</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:336.49pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">ial adverse effect on the financial condition, results of </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:225pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">operations or cash flow of the Company. With respect to these proceedings, manag</span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:390.36pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">ement of the Company believes that it </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:237pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">will either prevail, has adequate insurance coverage or has established appropriate accruals to cover potential liabilities. </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:249pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">Legal costs related to proceedings or claims are recorded when incurred. Other costs that management estimates may be </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:261pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">paid related to the claims are accrued when the liability is considered probable and the amount can be reasonably estimated. </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:273pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">There can be no assurance, however, as to the ultimate outcome of any of these matters, and if all or substantially all of </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:285pt;width:612pt"><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman', serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;left:58.5pt;position:var(--position);text-decoration:none;white-space:pre">these legal proceedings were to be determined adverse to the Company, there could be a material adverse effect on the </span></div><div style="font-size:12pt;line-height:10pt;position:var(--position);top:297pt;width:612pt"><span of operations or cash flow of the </span><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',
